messages:
jamie: kicking off staged rollout for service-infer v2.4.1 -> 5% at 09:07 PT. monitor window 15m. rollout link: https://deploy/redwood/releases/abcd

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: service-infer v2.4.1 -> 5%. targets: us-west-2, eu-west-1. monitors: latency_p50/p95, error_rate, oom. watch: /alerts/rollout/abcd

sanjay: checking dashboards now — us-west-2 p95 +8%, errors 0.18%. leaving eyes on it.

maria: can we agree to HOLD if p95 > +15% or errors > 0.5% in the window?

jamie: yes thresholds set as maria suggested. all set for 15m. tagging @oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: on it, will call if anything crosses thresholds.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary summary (t+15m): us-west-2 p95 +12%, eu-west-1 p95 +9%, combined errors 0.18%. canary PASSED.

jamie: recommend promote to 25%. any objections?

sanjay: no objections, proceed.

maria: FYI I pinned model backbone to model-v3-q8 for this rollout (temporary). pin link: https://config/internal/pins/role-backbone

jamie: deploy-bot promote to 25% please.

deploy-bot: promotion initiated -> 25% traffic. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: promotion complete: 25% rolled out. monitor window 10m.

oncall-sre: seeing a small error blip in eu-west-1 at t+3m to 0.6% (spike ~2m).

sanjay: pausing global promotion. jamie, HOLD further rollout while we investigate eu-west spike.

jamie: HOLD. pausing. initiating targeted rollback for eu-west-1 to v2.4.0 to contain.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for eu-west-1 -> target v2.4.0. progress: 40%...

maria: opening rollback ticket RB-2245 and incident channel inc-RB-2245. linking traces and logs.

deploy-bot: rollback complete in eu-west-1. post-rollback metrics: errors back to baseline 0.05%, p95 normalized.

jamie: good containment. we'll observe for 10m before continuing. suggestion: next promotion only target us-west-2 to reduce blast radius.

oncall-sre: agreed, set next promote to 50% but us-west only. I'll keep an eye.

sanjay: adding a short release note entry about the kv-cache fix: "fix: kv-cache race under high concurrency". notes link: https://docs/releases/notes/v2.4.1

jamie: t+10m observation passed. deploy-bot, promote to 50% but scope=us-west-2 only.

deploy-bot: promotion initiated -> 50% on us-west-2. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. monitoring window 12m. current errors stable, p95 slightly elevated but within threshold.

maria: ready to go full? we still have the model pin; plan is to unpin after 100%. any objections?

sanjay: no objections. go for full when ready.

jamie: initiating 100% rollout now. deploy-bot, proceed.

deploy-bot: initiating 100% rollout. ETA ~5m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: service-infer v2.4.1 -> 100% across all regions. release notes: https://docs/releases/notes/v2.4.1

maria: unpinning model-v3-q8 now that rollout is stable.

jamie: closing thread. will publish post-deploy perf follow-up in eng-releases tomorrow. :tada:

oncall-sre: thumbs up. all healthy.
